reflections.summary: Team preview was poor: Corviknight died immediately to Rotom-Wash Thunderbolt, killing our Tailwind plan; Medicham was brought with Medichamite but never Mega evolved, wasting its speed/power and leaving it useless; Aegislash fell early, isolating Archaludon, which Rotom slowly chipped through Stamina boosts with Leftovers Thunderbolts. The opponent’s Intimidate/spread core (Incineroar, Mamoswine, Aerodactyl) punished our passive setup, and Unnerve made berry reliance risky.
reflections.adjustment: Mega evolve Medicham on entry in game 3 to outspeed and pressure Rotom-Wash/Incineroar with Pure Power, and lead Aegislash for Wide Guard against spread Earthquake/Rock Slide instead of relying on Corviknight for Tailwind.
reflections.notebook: Durable opponent: Rotom-Wash always present (Leftovers, Thunderbolt, outspeeds Archaludon); Incineroar (Intimidate, Chople Berry, Fake Out/Darkest Lariat/Parting Shot); Mamoswine (Life Orb, Thick Fat, spread EQ/Ice Shard); Aerodactyl (Focus Sash, Unnerve—blocks berry heals, Tailwind, Wide Guard, Taunt). Revealed: Unnerve nullifies Chesto/Rest; Rotom chips through Stamina; Corviknight cannot survive Electric line. Future: never leave Medichamite unused; KO Rotom early with Mega Medicham or Shadow Ball; do not depend on Corviknight Tailwind or Chesto Rest when Aerodactyl may be present; preserve Aegislash for Wide Guard.

reflections.summary: Won because the Incineroar+Rotom-Wash core is a hard counter to the opponent's Archaludon wincon: Flash Cannon is resisted by Incineroar and does ~5% to Rotom (out-healed by Leftovers), while Darkest Lariat ignores Stamina/Iron Defense boosts and Thunderbolt chips steadily, so the Rest-loop never stabilized. Corviknight's failed double-Protect under repeated Thunderbolt pressure handed a free KO, and even a wasted Mamoswine (OHKO'd by Flash Cannon on switch-in) didn't matter — Rotom solo closed
reflections.adjustment: Drop Mamoswine from the bring versus this opponent — it is paper vs Flash Cannon and was donated for nothing on the turn-10 switch; use the slot on a safer pivot or second answer to Aegislash/Medicham. In-game, never switch Mamo into Archaludon, and preserve Incineroar's HP earlier (it entered the endgame at 22%) so the Lariat+Thunderbolt burst isn't reliant on Rotom's 1v1 out-heal.
reflections.notebook: SERIES WON 2-0 (p2). OPP ROSTER: Mega Medicham (PurePower; CC/ShadowBall/FakeOut/Protect; Jolly), Aegislash (ShadowBall/KingsShield/WideGuard/Protect; LifeOrb Quiet), Stunfisk-G (EQ/SR/TWave/Protect; Leftovers Mimicry), Volcarona (QD/FireBlast/BugBuzz/Protect; FocusSash Timid), Corviknight (Tailwind/Roost/BraveBird/Protect; Sitrus MirrorArmor Impish), Archaludon (Rest/SleepTalk/IronDef/FlashCannon; Chesto Stamina Calm). OPP TENDENCY: brings Medi/Aegi/Corv/Arch; leaves Stunfisk-G and Volcarona home; Archaludon is the anchor/wincon (Rest-loop). VERIFIED CALCS: Steel does NOT resist Dark — Lariat NEUTRAL vs Arch, ignores Def/Stamina = 24.9-42.4%/hit, THE answer. Rotom Tbolt vs Arch 0.5x = 17.3-33.9%. Arch FC vs Incin resisted 14.4-24.7%; vs Rotom 0.25x ~5% — Rotom out-heals with Leftovers and beats Arch 1v1 even through fresh-Chesto Rest-loop (SleepTalk FC can't outpace Leftovers+Tbolt). FB vs Corv 71.7-124.9%; Tbolt vs Corv 62.9-114.5%. Arch FC vs Mamo 95-135% — Mamo is a liability, do NOT bring or switch into Arch. Mega CC OHKOs Mamo even at -2; Incin tanks CC via Chople+Intimidate. RULES: Parting Shot fails with empty bench; never Parting Shot Corv (Mirror Armor); Fake Out only first turn out; repeated attacks into Protect streaks pay off (Corv died to failed double Protect). FUTURE PLAN vs this opponent: bring Incin+Rotom core + Aerodactyl (Tailwind) + a non-Mamo fourth; burst Arch with Lariat+Tbolt before Rest stabilizes; keep Incin healthy for the endgame.
